notes.subject: לאשר
notes.rationale: KJV 'unto him from whom' i tanim סרה olsem narapela tok (fram ol narapela man), JPS/ASV 'against whom ye have deeply rebelled' — סרה i stap wantaim לאשר olgeta

notes.subject: שובו
notes.rationale: Imperatif 'kirap bek' — singaut bilong ol pikinini bilong Yisrael ol i go long rot nogut

notes.subject: בני ישראל
notes.rationale: Tok i go stret long ol pikinini bilong Yisrael

translation: Kirap bek long em, long we ol pikinini bilong Yisrael i go daun tru long pasin bilong lusolhet.

tokens.gloss: ol i go daun tru long
